name: Vero
description: Vero is a customer messaging platform with a stable Track API plus public-preview APIs for broadcast and journey structure and draft content.
agentUseSummary: Connect dedicated tracking and Campaigns API keys for the exact project. Relay pins 24 v2 operations: ten campaign-structure reads run directly, two content-body reads and 12 customer/event/draft mutations require approval, and profile creation, event ingestion, and resubscription also require explicit recorded consent attestation.

credentialRequirements.name: VERO_TRACKING_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Vero tracking API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-owned Tracking API key for the exact Vero project.

credentialRequirements.name: VERO_CAMPAIGNS_API_SECRET_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Vero Campaigns API secret key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated Campaigns API secret key after Vero grants public-preview access.

capabilities.label: Read campaign structure
capabilities.description: Use ten bounded broadcast and journey metadata, graph, message, and content-variant reads.

capabilities.label: Read message content
capabilities.description: Use two exact broadcast or journey content-body reads with approval.

capabilities.label: Manage tracking and drafts
capabilities.description: Use six Track API mutations and six unscheduled broadcast-draft mutations with approval.

allowed.label: Read Vero campaign structure
allowed.description: Read bounded broadcast and journey metadata, graphs, messages, and content-variant metadata.

approvalRequired.label: Read Vero message content
approvalRequired.description: Read exact broadcast or journey message content bodies.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Vero tracking and drafts
approvalRequired.description: Identify or update users, track events, manage tags/subscriptions/aliases, and create or update unscheduled broadcast drafts.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Tracking keys, Campaigns API secret keys, authorization headers, and credential-bearing URLs never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Delete or export data
blocked.description: User deletion, campaign/customer exports, bulk imports, arbitrary pagination, and destructive administration are excluded.

blocked.label: Send, schedule, or configure delivery
blocked.description: Audience/scheduling, publishing, live sends, webhooks, domains, delivery providers, key administration, and send-mode changes remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only 24 pinned v2 operations run on api.getvero.com with bounded input/output and a pinned Campaigns API revision; arbitrary routes, origins, headers, and browser tracking are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Ten structural reads run directly; two content reads and all 12 Track/draft mutations require approval, with explicit consent attestation for profile creation, event ingestion, and resubscription.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 24 selected operations run without Relay per-action approval; fixed v2 routing, pinned revision, bounds, audits, consent attestation, and delete/export/send/setup blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts bounded Vero tools, injects encrypted keys by API family, and pins the Campaigns API revision.
Railway mounts bounded Vero tools, injects encrypted keys by API family, and pins the Campaigns API revision.

providerSetup.blocker: Vero requires a customer-owned project and tracking key; Campaigns API access is a public preview granted by Vero on request and uses a separate one-time-visible secret. No console, account, access request, key, consent, customer data, message, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Obtain Campaigns API access outside this worker, configure dedicated project keys in Railway staging, and verify project binding, structural/content reads, approval and consent-attestation denial/allow, tracking and draft edits, bounds, revision behavior, rate limits, key revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Vero documents the fixed https://api.getvero.com/api/v2 origin, stable Track API body-key authentication, Campaigns API Authorization authentication, and public-preview access requirement.
Vero documents POST /users/track, profile create-or-update behavior, update-only support, and stale-data rejection semantics.
Vero documents POST /events/track, implicit profile creation, and event deduplication behavior.
Vero documents the bounded cursor-paginated broadcast read, Authorization header, permissions, and optional dated revision.
Vero documents unscheduled broadcast-draft creation and currently rejects audience and schedule fields, which Relay blocks explicitly.
